notes: Focused public C++ TCK contract for the IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.5 p. 356 l. 326-108-join authorization path. The current-package adapter selects a custom Authorizer provider through a protected RTI Initialization Data profile. The TCK creates a federation, requires Unauthorized from a denied Join Federation Execution, retries the same join successfully, then resigns and destroys the federation. This bounded local service-behavior evidence is not full §12.5 conformance or provider interoperability evidence.
